added.summary: One input binding drawn the same everywhere: an action's glyph on the device used last, or a key cap from `keyLabel` (`pad` for a round face button, `pressed`, `disabled`, sizes sm/md/lg). InteractionPrompt, Hint, RpgPrompt, ShooterPrompt, AmmoCounter, LoadingScreen, SplashScreen and CreditsScreen draw their keys with it.

added.member: Badge, Divider, IconButton, TextField, TextArea, RichText
added.summary: New controls: a status tag or count (`Badge.frame.<tone>`, `Badge.dot`), a labelled hairline (`Divider.line`, `Divider.label`), an icon-only button on the Button plates (`IconButton.frame`), labelled text fields with hint, error and count (`Field.label`, `Field.hint`, `Field.error`), and text in toned spans with glossary keywords (`RichText.keyword`, `RichText.gloss`).

A cast or channel bar: icon, name and remaining time (tenths under ten seconds) over a fill that follows `elapsed / duration`, draining for `channel`; `locked` and `interrupted` show through `data-locked` and `data-interrupted`. Dressed by `CastBar.frame`, `CastBar.track`, `CastBar.fill`.
Non-blocking keyed banners at the top centre (achievements, milestones): each enters with the unlock cue and plays its exit while `leaving`; the game owns the queue. Dressed by `BannerQueue.item`.
Lay the gameplay HUD out from the regions a player saved in HudEditorScreen, inside the safe area; save and restore the regions as text, merged over the game's defaults.
`renderRegion` draws the live HUD element inside each region's tile.

A control rebinding screen: keyboard and gamepad columns, category filter, search, conflicts and locked bindings marked; `onRebind` asks the game to capture the next input, `onClear`, `onReset`, `onBack`.
A marker or blip with `pinned` stays on the rim, dimmed, when out of range (MinimapView adds a tick pointing its way); MinimapView markers take `elevation` (`above`, `below`) and draw a chevron.
`leftHanded` mirrors the layout: the stick at the end side, the buttons and look stick at the start side.

fixed.summary: Play the tick haptic when pressed.
